edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: In the lung, retained asbestos fibers drive oxidative stress, fibrosis, and DNA damage; smoking adds a well-known synergistic carcinogenic burden.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Koehoorn meta analysis in Occup Environ Med, which ties asbestos exposure to lung cancer in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
